An highly religious '''woman''' of extremely rigid moral principles once founded [[Jesa Corporation]], appointing like-minded indiviuals as company officials. She was considered by many to have strange personal beliefs, a conservative approach to things and very fundamentalist ideals.<ref name="GG6" />

When Jesa Corp became the first settlers of [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pergitor]] in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster Node]] and turned it into a thriving [[Mining/Legends|mining]] and manufactoring planet serving as the corporation's major training and research center, their founder became the leader of the strongly united society of pious individuals that had started to form.<ref name="GG6" /> Around [[105 BBY]] due to a mining disater the world was covered in ash for various [[Standard year/Legends|years]] and its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was made unbreathable, forcing its population to retreat into sealed buildings and causing Jesa Corporation to declare bankruptcy, leaving the planet's society with a devastated economy. During the crisis, with everyone being more interested in survival than anything else, the society on the planet turned into a despotism under the control of the [[Royal family of Pergitor|royal family]], composed of descendants of Jesa Corp's founder.<ref name="GG6" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jesa Corporation's founder, alongside Pergitor and its history, was first mentioned in [[West End Games]]' [[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters|Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]. Despite it not giving a precise date for the events it covers, Galaxy Guides are supplements to WEG's [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]] which is set in the years after [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope]] but before [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back]]. Dating the supplement to the time period of the core rulebook would place the bore mining disaster that caused Jesa's shut down in roughly [[95 BBY]], having happened nearly 100 years before the Guide's present-day.
